From the story line of salvation, marvel at the endless grace; from the illuminated episode, look at the impossibilities of the world.
Whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honorable, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are clean, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report, if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, these things think ye upon. Philippians 4:8.
The testimonies of more than thirty people in this book, like the “cloud of witnesses” in Hebrews 11, inspire our faith and show us through the stories of their lives that God can be trusted! Blessed indeed are those who trust in God! They were ordinary people like you and me, but because of God's work in them, they all became God's heroes of faith.
